description: Bounded offline public reference, not a complete public-person catalog. No family data was sent to prepare it.

queries: SELECT ?person ?label WHERE { ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5; wdt:P106 wd:Q177220; rdfs:label ?label. FILTER(LANG(?label)="zh-cn") FILTER(STRLEN(?label)>=2 && STRLEN(?label)<=5) } ORDER BY ?person LIMIT 2000

SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?personLabel WHERE { VALUES ?country {wd:Q865 wd:Q8646 wd:Q148} ?person wdt:P27 ?country; wdt:P106 wd:Q177220. SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "zh-hans,zh,en". } } LIMIT 1500
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?personLabel WHERE { ?person wdt:P27 wd:Q865; wdt:P106 wd:Q177220. SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "zh-hans,zh,en". } } LIMIT 1000
catalog.transformation: Union successful 1500-row regional and 977-row Taiwan query responses; retain 2..5 Han labels; deduplicate by entity and spelling. Initial and expanded queries timed out and supplied no data. No per-story name mapping.

readings.transformation: Keep U+3400..U+9FFF, strip tone diacritics, map ü to v, deduplicate readings; no per-name pronunciation rules.
